title: Transaction state vector and legal transitions in @counter/workflow
description: Implement the transaction state vector with orchestration phases, independent sub-states, optimistic versioning, and pure transition functions with exhaustive tests.
acceptance_criteria: All orchestration phases defined as const arrays with derived types
All sub-state enums (reservation, payment, order, fulfillment, return) defined
TransactionState interface with all fields frozen
TransitionError discriminated union with typed codes
Legal transition tables as readonly data
Pure transition functions returning Result<NewState, TransitionError>
Exhaustive tests for all legal and illegal transitions
findings: Added phase guards to all sub-state transition functions per review
Added 'declining' intermediate payment sub-state per requirements spec
Added prerequisite enforcement for FAILED_REQUIRES_ACTION -> COMMITTING (payment must be advanced)
518 total tests passing after review fixes
